quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards or special conditions ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does a flashing red traffic light mean?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
Only stop to yield to other traffic.
Vehicles will be entering the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must stop completely, let all traffic and pedestrians pass, and then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions like curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors and road maintenance vehicles display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow traffic light mean?

options.text: The traffic light is about to change to red.
The traffic light is about to change to green.
Stop and wait for traffic to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: The traffic light is about to change to red.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow light warns you that the light will soon turn red. Slow down and stop before the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are already in the intersection, continue through it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. It is illegal to turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that a side road is coming up ahead. Stay alert for traffic from that side road.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that lanes are being reduced ahead. Merge left to stay in a lane that continues.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a crosswalk. Watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that bicycles may be crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to allow traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs mean you are in or approaching a school zone. Watch for children and follow posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign shows a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop for trains.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks orange during the day and red at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you cannot enter. You may see it on one-way streets or when entering an expressway ramp in the wrong direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs mean you are approaching a school zone. Stay alert and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that the right lane will end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is on the back of slow-moving vehicles. These vehicles move slower than 25 mph. Examples include farm equipment, construction vehicles, and horse-drawn wagons.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will curve right first, then curve left. Slow down to stay safe on these curves.

questions.question: This sign is a:
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing downward is always a yield sign. You must be ready to slow down or stop at a yield sign.

questions.question: This sign tells a driver that:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange, yellow, or bright jackets. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on roadways. You must stop completely. Do not move until it is safe and clear to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: A sign with this shape means:
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks where a no passing zone begins.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road will turn sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the divided highway will end. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
Stop completely, then go when safe.
Go through carefully without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when safe.
questions.explanation: An octagon sign means stop. You must stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop where you can see traffic coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Drive carefully on wet roads.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Be ready for traffic or to turn.

questions.question: What message is on a red octagon-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: An octagon sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: A pentagon-shaped sign is a:

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign alerts drivers to school zones. Some show where children or pedestrians may cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for vehicles with disability license plates or disability parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a two-way road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to areas where bicycles, animals, and pedestrians may cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming. Begin to slow down when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws you must follow. This sign means drive only in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangle sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right for road construction.

questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn you of hazards ahead. This sign tells you to slow down for a sharp turn in the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down to avoid collisions and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond signs warn of hazards. Orange is used for construction and maintenance areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: This sign means you must yield. Slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross your path. Stop if necessary before going forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: White signs with red and black markings show traffic rules. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This sign warns of what ahead?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Vehicles will be entering the roadway.
Come to a complete stop and proceed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when safe.
questions.explanation: Red octagonal signs are always stop signs. You must come to a complete stop, check for other traffic and pedestrians, and proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road ahead?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will curve to the right, then curve to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Do not drive toward it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downgrade is coming. Check your brakes before you go down the hill.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that you are leaving a one-way highway. You will soon drive on a road with traffic moving in both directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic from another lane may be merging ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead becomes slippery when it rains or is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black symbols. This sign warns you that traffic ahead is merging.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order for traffic lights?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead at an intersection.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You may see this sign at intersections where oncoming traffic is heavy.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is near. Look and listen for trains, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black symbols and alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that the road ahead is divided.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic is merging into your lane from the right.

questions.question: This yellow warning sign means:

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools. It warns you to slow down, drive carefully, and look for children.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road conditions. This sign warns that the road ahead has many curves. Adjust your speed for the curves.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards. This sign warns that pedestrians may cross the road ahead. Stop and wait if a pedestrian is crossing.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a side road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep hill or downgrade is coming.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a steep hill or downgrade ahead. It may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road will change direction or become narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will change direction or become narrower.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a road direction change or narrowing. You may see these signs on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road has many curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road may be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to immediate conditions ahead. This sign warns of an upcoming curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The crossing is controlled. Drive at your normal speed.
Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the tracks and wait for a signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: How much space is between the road and a bridge or overpass.
The tallest vehicle allowed in this state.
The widest vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: How much space is between the road and a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows the distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass (12 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?
questions.explanation: Blue signs provide service information. They tell you about nearby rest areas, food, gas, hospitals, and other driver services.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must go either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must go either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road splits ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to immediate conditions. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what they must or must not do. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic moves in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always warns that a railroad crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes going the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning right or left.

questions.question: This sign indicates a:
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. Round signs are used only to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, what should you do?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard tells you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow sign means you are near a school. Stay alert and stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down; the road curves ahead.
Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does an orange sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction areas. Drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Roads become slippery and dangerous when wet. This sign warns you that wet pavement can cause you to lose control. Slow down when you see wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange is used for work zones. If you see orange signs, cones, or barrels, stay alert for unexpected driving conditions. This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. You must follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: When you see a stop sign, what should you do?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop and check all directions for traffic before proceeding.

questions.question: You see this sign at a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Keep a steady speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if any are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if any are nearby.
questions.explanation: At this railroad crossing, slow down and look and listen for trains. Be prepared to stop. Never try to drive faster than an oncoming train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black lettering or symbols. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign alerts drivers to be ready for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they cannot turn left. Turning left at this intersection is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Go 35 mph or slower through the upcoming curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go 35 mph or slower through the upcoming curve.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to dangers ahead. A speed advisory sign below the warning tells you the safe speed to use.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.
